findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs" appears informational but accepts parameters (command) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.narev.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Private data: calculate_cost, query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Private data: calculate_cost, query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
